description: User story under REQ-190 for the guidance train (FBS-224). The Build hand rewrites build-cycle.md stages 1, 4 and 5, the playbook, the bundle closing runbook, the managed agent-instructions block (minAgentAction set) and the README, and replaces the fifth verb attest with audit.
asA: an agent or operator reading rcf-lite's method through the CLI
iWant: the stage contract the tool prints to match what the tool enforces
soThat: nobody follows guidance that sends verification after merge or names a verb that does not exist

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] When rcf guidance build-cycle runs, then the Test stage text names the verifier hand, rcf verify run --fbs <fbs-id> --hand verifier against the preview or version host, the committed report under rcf/verify-reports/ and the merge gate (Review MERGE plus Test PASS); the Finalise stage text names CI green, merge, rcf build mark <fbs-id> complete and rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> ingesting the report; and the output contains neither "--url <deploy-url>" on the finalise line nor "post-merge verify run".
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: TEST runs the full RCF suite against a locally running app and Verify sits outside the cycle; no Test-stage verify run against a host (ADR ADR-4161, redesign change 7).

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] When rcf guidance build-cycle runs, then the Define stage text names the test-author hand writing AC-based and E2E tests and TS/TC bindings, the Build stage names the builder writing production code, Code Nodes and code-hygiene unit tests only, and every stage names its Hand: trailer value.
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: stages are named by commit prefix and role; the hand vocabulary goes (ADR ADR-4161, ADR ADR-4153).

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] When rcf build bundle --next --format md emits a bundle, then its closing runbook lists the five stages with their hands, the rcf verify run Test-stage command with --hand verifier, rcf audit separation, and the rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> line, and no finalise line carries --mode or --url.
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: the bundle runbook lists verdict, test-strength and Finalise steps and names Verify outside the round, with no --hand verifier step (ADR ADR-4161).

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] When rcf guidance managed/agent-instructions-block runs after the release, then the block states that verified is written only by rcf build finalise from a Test-stage report, the release notes carry a non-null minAgentAction telling agents to refresh the block with rcf doctor, and rcf doctor reports the old block as drifted.
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: the managed block states that a release Verify writes verified and Finalise writes complete; the feed entry for this block change is 0.37.0 with rerun-init (ADR ADR-4161).

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] When the README at the repository root and every guidance topic printed by rcf guidance are searched for the stage chain, then the fifth verb reads audit (define, build, verify, release, audit) and attest appears nowhere as a verb or stage name; the unrelated AC attestation vocabulary and the --litmus-attested flag stay as they are.

[failure] Given a project whose CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md carries the pre-change managed block, when rcf doctor runs with the new release, then it reports the managed block as drifted, names rcf doctor --fix as the refresh command and does not exit 0.

[must-not] no guidance topic printed by rcf guidance and no bundle runbook from rcf build bundle --next tells a hand to run rcf build finalise with --mode or --url, or to run verification after merge.
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: Verify now runs after the deploy to preview, outside the cycle, so "no verification after merge" no longer holds as worded; the successor forbids verification inside the cycle and the retired Finalise flags (ADR ADR-4161).

title: Guidance, the managed agent-instructions block and the README say the new stage contract, and audit is the fifth verb
